descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-21 Hospital vs. Nursing-Home Context Switch · S25 「标记数据在任何页面都不跨模式：列表、病历、搜索、dashboard、Task Export、Inbox、多病人 Handoff」 Marker data never crosses contexts on any screen: lists, charts, search, dashboard, Task Export, Inbox, multi-patient Handoff

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U6 No data or template leakage between Hospital and Nursing Home. This covers lists, charts, the template picker, custom templates, account-wide screens (search, dashboard counts, Task Export, Inbox, mu …（UAT TC-21；TFA-92599 AC 5） — gate: blocked: TFA-92599 in progress

测试设计方法：错误推测（error-guessing） — 专门去撞最容易出错的地方（失败、重复点、两个标签页、时钟不对、注入的指令）。

Given Fixture extended with distinctive marker data per context. Hospital patient: pre-round 'MARK-H-PR T21 overnight fever resolved', Important Point 'MARK-H ip T21', open task 'MARK-H task T21 follow up BMP', Quick Dictation box 'MARK-H qd T21'. …

When Visit each context's list, Pre-Round chart, search (query 'Resident' in Hospital, 'Hosp' in Nursing Home), dashboard, Task Export / task review, the Handoffs inbox and the multi-patient Handoff sheet

Then Each screen shows its own context's markers where they belong, and never the other context's markers or patient. Dashboard totals equal the context's own count (1).

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：oracle.mjs. The own-context markers on the chart and task screens are positive controls, so a run on an unseeded fixture fails instead of passing vacuously. Every screen mustNotContain the other context's marker prefix ('MARK-H' / 'MARK-N') and patient. Scope beyond lists and charts is Q5; it is tested meanwhile.

在哪跑：dev；测试方法 AGENT · 浏览器 agent；矩阵里排的车道 浏览器 agent（blocked）

S25 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-21.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：dev — dev 部署，build e02167f（Deploy Convex，2026-10-12T18:24:27Z）；账号和地址不写进报告；run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev。

测试方法：AGENT · 浏览器 agent；辅助：API · 接口（Convex 函数） — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：dev。
